DISCLOSURES: The mint pipeline regenerates integrity metadata at build time; a second mint of the same tree would produce a zip with a different SHA-256 (different generated_at and regenerated lock digests) while carrying a byte-identical content payload.

The tree-level checksums file (manifest/sha256sums.txt) references 760 .agents paths but only 129 are packaged; this is the pre-existing designed behavior of the mint (tree snapshot vs selected roots) and is identical in both the final and rebuilt artifacts - uniformity confirmed.

The mint's run_gate step re-invokes lock-runtime inside the stage, so the packaged runtime lock is a second-order regeneration; the packaged checksums file captures the state before that second regeneration. Both final and rebuilt artifacts exhibit the identical internal ordering, confirming the pipeline is deterministic in structure.
